SCHOOL STATEMENT.

STATEMENT OF Indian Day Schools in the Dominion (from which returns have been received) for the Fiscal Year ended March 31, 1916.

NOTE. - The 'Standard' indicates the classification of the pupils according to the reading book used and, therefore, shows the degree of general
advancement in all the studies prescribed by the curriculum, thus: -

Standard I First Reader, Part I   Standard IV Third Reader.
Standard II Second Reader Part II Standard V Fourth Reader.
Standard III Second Reader        Standard VI Fifth Reader.
